sections.title: Review: Boardwalk Builders (Nintendo Switch)
text: Boardwalk Builders offers a charming, stress-free seaside management experience, with delightful pixel art and soothing music.Its accessible gameplay and engaging business-merging mechanics provide a relaxing blend of creativity and strategy.

sections.title: Review: Viral Reload EX (Nintendo Switch)
text: Viral Reload EX delivers fast-paced, challenging arcade action with intuitive controls and a satisfying dash mechanic.Its minimalist gameplay and classic shoot ’em up design capture the spirit of old-school arcade games.

sections.title: Review: Living Dead House (Nintendo Switch)
text: Living Dead House perfectly captures the spirit of classic ’80s arcade games with engaging zombie-survival action, strategic gameplay, and a well-balanced difficulty curve.Its retro visuals, local co-op mode, and addictive short-session gameplay deliver plenty of nostalgic fun.

sections.title: Review: Silver Bullet (Nintendo Switch)
text: Silver Bullet delivers thrilling old-school arcade action with precise controls, intense boss battles, and charming pixel art.Its satisfying gameplay, excellent sound design, and rewarding scoring system offer a nostalgic and highly replayable experience.

sections.title: Review: Flora & Fang: Guardians of the Vampire Garden (Nintendo Switch)
text: Flora & Fang: Guardians of the Vampire Garden combines nostalgic ’80s arcade action with engaging tower defense mechanics, strategic upgrades, and challenging boss battles.Its charming retro visuals, responsive controls, and fun local co-op gameplay deliver an exciting and highly replayable experience.

sections.title: Review: Skies Above (Nintendo Switch)
text: Skies Above delivers a unique and charming arcade experience, combining nostalgic 16-bit visuals, immersive sound design, and simple yet engaging gameplay.Its creative flying-whale concept, satisfying upgrades, and increasingly challenging action make it a fun and rewarding adventure.

sections.title: Review: Freddy Farmer (Nintendo Switch)
text: Freddy Farmer brings classic ’80s and ’90s arcade action to life with charming retro visuals, nostalgic sound design, and creative gameplay mechanics.Its varied levels, randomized challenges, and unlockable mini-games offer an enjoyable experience for fans of old-school platformers.

sections.title: Review: Super Spy Raccoon (Nintendo Switch)
text: Super Spy Raccoon brilliantly combines classic arcade action with clever stealth mechanics, challenging stages, and strategic timing.Its addictive gameplay and rewarding high-score system make it a superb experience that keeps players coming back for more.

sections.title: Review: Cash Cow DX (Nintendo Switch)
text: Cash Cow DX delivers fast-paced, old-school arcade fun with colorful retro visuals, clever level design, and exciting score-chasing mechanics.Its responsive movement, creative obstacles, and rewarding gameplay offer a thrilling and nostalgic experience for classic arcade fans.

sections.title: Review: Looking Up I See Only A Ceiling (PC)
text: Looking Up I See Only a Ceiling delivers a memorable psychological horror experience with beautiful hand-drawn, manga-inspired artwork and an eerie, atmospheric soundtrack.Its intriguing storytelling, intuitive puzzles, and bonus Explore Mode create an enjoyable and immersive adventure.

sections.title: Review: Satryn DX (Nintendo Switch)
text: Satryn DX delivers thrilling twin-stick arcade action with responsive controls, vibrant psychedelic visuals, and exciting power-ups.Its varied enemies, rewarding score-multiplier system, and online leaderboards make it an addictive experience for fans of classic arcade shooters.

sections.title: Review: Goliath Depot (Nintendo Switch)
text: Goliath Depot captures the magic of classic ’80s arcade games with creative level design, diverse enemies, and exciting environmental challenges.Its rewarding power-ups, unlockable characters, and additional game modes deliver a fresh, highly replayable arcade experience.

sections.title: Review: 8-Colors Star Guardians + (Nintendo Switch)
text: 8-Colors Star Guardians + delivers a clever blend of turn-based combat and puzzle-like strategy, rewarding careful planning and smart decisions.Its charming NES-inspired visuals, creative boss battles, and unique grind-free RPG mechanics offer a refreshing retro gaming experience.

sections.title: Review: Colored Effects (Nintendo Switch)
text: Colored Effects delivers an outstanding puzzle-platforming experience with incredibly precise controls, clever color-based abilities, and creative level design.Its clean visuals, intuitive mechanics, and rewarding logic puzzles make it a highly enjoyable and accessible game.

sections.title: Review: Sentry City (Nintendo Switch)
text: Sentry City stands out with its slick visuals, polished presentation, and promising arcade-action concept.TouchArcade also highlights Flynn’s Arcade’s talent for publishing authentic-feeling arcade games, noting that Sentry City offers enjoyable moments for the right audience.

sections.title: Review: Murtop (Nintendo Switch)
text: Murtop delivers delightful retro arcade action, blending the classic gameplay of Dig Dug and Bomberman with creative bomb mechanics and challenging levels.Its rewarding scoring system, 256 stages, and excellent value make it a highly replayable experience for fans of old-school arcade games.

sections.title: Review: Papertris (Nintendo Switch)
text: Papertris puts a clever spin on classic puzzle gameplay with innovative layered mechanics, challenging levels, and charming hand-drawn visuals.Its fantastic soundtrack, engaging game modes, and affordable price make it an easy recommendation for puzzle fans.

sections.title: Review: Donut Dodo (Nintendo Switch)
text: Donut Dodo brilliantly recreates the magic of classic ’80s arcade games with vibrant retro visuals, an excellent chiptune soundtrack, and clever level design.Its strategic gameplay, challenging stages, and worldwide leaderboards deliver an authentic and rewarding arcade experience.

sections.title: Review: A Winding Path (Nintendo Switch)
text: A Winding Path offers a charming and relaxing adventure with beautiful hand-drawn visuals, soothing audio, and a magical atmosphere.Its clever writing, accessible puzzles, and gentle pacing create a delightful and immersive experience full of heart.

sections.title: Review: Galacticon (Nintendo Switch)
text: Galacticon brilliantly captures the spirit of classic ’80s arcade games, blending Defender and Joust-inspired action with vibrant neon visuals and authentic retro sound.Its creative rescue mechanics, bonus stages, and global leaderboards deliver an addictive, nostalgic, and highly replayable arcade experience.

sections.title: Review: Dexter Stardust: Adventures in Outer Space (Nintendo Switch)
text: Dexter Stardust: Adventures in Outer Space delivers a charming sci-fi point-and-click adventure with witty storytelling, colorful cartoon visuals, and excellent voice acting.Its cleverly designed puzzles, lovable characters, and engaging episodic narrative create a fun and memorable experience from start to finish.

sections.title: Review: Lambs on the Road: The Beginning (Nintendo Switch)
text: Lambs on the Road: The Beginning delivers a dark, atmospheric post-apocalyptic adventure with intriguing environmental storytelling and a distinctive art style.Its satisfying puzzles, engaging exploration, and mysterious narrative provide a strong foundation that leaves players eager for more.

sections.title: To appreciate modern life, I can’t stop playing games about death
text: What Comes After delivers a delightfully charming and heartfelt narrative, blending whimsical storytelling with meaningful reflections on life, death, and self-worth.Its imaginative characters, thoughtful writing, and uplifting message create a touching and emotionally rewarding experience.

sections.title: When you decide to look back and nostalgically recall your first games
text: Eternum Ex brilliantly captures the nostalgia of classic arcade games with beautifully detailed 16-bit pixel art, energetic music, and addictive gameplay.Its progressively challenging levels, simple controls, and well-balanced difficulty deliver an authentic and rewarding retro gaming experience.
